title: barringtonia rumphiana
intro: Barringtonia rumphiana, commonly known as the Sea Poison or Kamal, is a plant species in the family Lecythidaceae. It has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, including its ability to treat fever, rheumatism, and skin infections. The health benefits of Barringtonia rumphiana include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial actions, which can help to reduce pain and prevent the growth of microorganisms. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.
